editorialRules.english: Model-written legal English after the Chinese draft is approved; never literal or browser translation.
editorialRules.visibleDate: Show one truthful last-updated date only.
editorialRules.publication: No backdating or fabricated random timestamps. A half-hour processor may publish 0, 1 or 2 genuinely ready stories per run. Publish only after source, legal, language, image and link checks pass.
editorialRules.citations: Research may use authoritative sources internally. Client-facing copy should explain the practical point in plain language and should not display formal state-law links unless counsel approves them.
qualityGate: adds facts or a decision path rather than keyword variants
has aligned Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and natural English versions
passes legal, date, hreflang, canonical and internal-link review

publicationWindow.countingRule: One story counts once; Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English pages do not count as three stories.
publicationWindow.timingRule: Release only genuinely ready stories and record the actual deployment time. Variation comes from editorial readiness, never fabricated timestamps or attempts to evade platform detection.
